ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity (white) pixels dominate approximately 90% of the visible surface, with low-intensity (black) pixels localized to the perimeter, tips, and sparse medial spots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity central region; dark pigmentation forms a continuous band along the superior margins and distal tips, with localized dark punctate clusters scattered in the medial and distal quadrants.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an approximate 50-degree interior angle and significant vertical depth relative to the lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Low-frequency, irregular peaks and valleys; higher amplitude serrations are visible on the distal third of each lobe, while the medial sections exhibit smoother undulating contours.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature originating from the median notch, transitioning to a convex curve as the lobes extend toward the lateral terminal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Visible clusters of high-contrast dark pixels on the extreme lateral tips of both lobes, consistent with barnacle colonization patterns.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of 4-5 parallel, dark horizontal linear markings (rake marks) located on the inferior midline area near the peduncle attachment.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Physical trauma marks present as parallel horizontal lines on the central inferior surface and parasitic/barnacle attachment clusters on the fluke tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Sparse, isolated circular dark pigment spots scattered across the high-intensity white ventral field, most notably in the upper-left and lower-central quadrants.
